observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection over authenticated Store session events

outcome.interpretation: The selected session event window is complete through sequence 62, but the RPC activity projection returns only 32 of 39 considered operations. One of three cited source event identities is present in that bounded RPC list; the other two remain unresolved because seven RPC records were omitted. This does not establish that the underlying events are missing.
outcome.analysis_limit: The projection does not identify which of the two unmatched source identities fell outside the selected RPC records. No cross-session recurrence or agent impact is established.
